recap.headline: STOPPING THE JIT AND KARTIK TANK 🛑 WEEK 9 RECAP

featured.hook: THE JIT TANK HAS BEEN STOPPED 🛑
featured.body: Sleeper had Arjun winning by 13.2. But Jit found a way yet again for a 4th straight win and finds himself in the playoffs hunt. Shedeur Sanders X Just in Time (Jit) collab for a clutch 22.7 points for the tiny win.

The trail of tears ends for STILL the points leader of the league and STILL the last place team of the league after a 4 game losing streak. Even this he barely won by a point. He finds himself two games away from the Playoffs. Will his tank stop too?

receipts.label: KC Concepcion Jr. on the bench

featured.hook: NO. 1 VS NO. 2 AND IT WASN'T CLOSE 📅
featured.body: Mateo won by 49.58, the biggest margin of the week. THE SCHEDULE returns and shows up big time in a No. 1 vs No. 2 matchup against Samurai Pipsqueak. Will the luck ever run out??
